title: Ankle injury
transcript:
Doctor: What happened to your ankle?
Patient: I rolled it playing football yesterday evening. It swelled up fast.
Doctor: Could you walk on it right after?
Patient: A few steps, limping.
Doctor: Any medical conditions? Do you take any medications?
Patient: No, nothing.
Doctor: There's swelling and bruising on the outside of the ankle. It's tender over the ligament but not over the bone, and you can take four steps on it. By the Ottawa ankle rules you don't need an X-ray. This is a grade 2 lateral ankle sprain. Rest it, ice it for 20 minutes every few hours, use a compression bandage and keep it elevated. Take ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day with food, for up to five days. Use crutches for the first few days.
Patient: When can I play again?
Doctor: Probably in three to four weeks. I'll refer you to physiotherapy. Come back if you can't put any weight on it or the pain gets worse.
